# Svelte UI Library Picker

> A secondary-source comparison of Svelte UI libraries: Svelte version support, components (mapped to a shared taxonomy), licenses, AI policies, maintenance status and live previews of default styles. Always defer to each library's official documentation, which every page links to.

## Pages

- [Libraries](./libraries/): all tracked libraries with filters; one page per library at ./libraries/<id>/
- [Components](./components/): every component type and which libraries provide it, with props tables and previews; one page per component at ./components/<id>/
- [Compare](./compare/): side-by-side matrix with live previews; state in ?libs=a,b&component=x&category=y
- [Port](./port/): prop-by-prop view of moving a component between two libraries; state in ?from=a&to=b&component=x
- [Tools](./tools/): single-purpose packages and building blocks (charts, toasts, maps, editors...); one page per tool at ./tools/<id>/
- [Features and badges](./guide/features/): what the feature tags and maintenance badges mean
- [Licenses & AI policy](./guide/licenses-and-ai/): how we use library material and respect AI boundaries
- [About](./guide/about/) and [Contributing](./guide/contributing/)

## Source data

- [Repository](https://github.com/AJayClauGermany/SvelteUILibraryPicker): one TypeScript file per library in src/lib/data/libraries/ and per tool in src/lib/data/tools/
